title.quote: Fast-Converging Simulated Annealing for Ising Models Based on Integral Stochastic Computing

extractions.description: This paper introduces a fast-converging simulated annealing (SA) method based on probabilistic bits (p-bits) designed using integral stochastic computing for solving combinatorial optimization problems. It compares the proposed method with conventional SA and quantum annealing (QA) on the traveling salesman, maximum cut (MAX-CUT), and graph isomorphism (GI) problems.
